title: Visualise NICE guidance documents in a network
text: goal visNICE display list publications produced NICE (UK National Institute Health Care Excellence) form network graphs. list publications can found (browsed list boxes) : https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/conditions--diseases visNICE produces results graphical form alternative means browsing. current version visNICE organises networks hierarchy produced NICE. NICE report prefix indicates type, follows: NG - Nice Guidance TA - Technology Assessment HST - Highly Specialised Technology CSG - Cancer Service Guideline HTG - HealthTech Guidance CG - Clinical Guideline

title: Visualise NICE guidance documents in a network

title: Visualise NICE guidance documents in a network
text: First make tree holds information. Typing name tree gives summary hierarchy, including list nodes first layer: plot whole tree, operation time-consuming, visNICE restricts full-tree plot top layers.  Now can take ‘cutting’ tree, means less information display, whole cutting subtree shown. choose urological conditions (UROLOG) root node. First make new smaller tree cutting command, summarise , plot . used interactively, Hovering nodes tree show listed reports.  might want look ‘specific’ node. use alternative command pipe (|>), avoid creating extra object (smaller tree).
